findings.description: The caption states 2 leaves of 0.610 x 2.032 x 0.035 m in hollow_core and a total of 9.0 kg. The stated area density is 7.2 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 18 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
